comment: Pinned model artefacts. Every digest here was verified against the
provider's API on the research date; see docs/research/TECHNOLOGY_RESEARCH.md.
Models are NEVER baked into an image and NEVER downloaded implicitly at
container start-up: they are licensed separately, they are hundreds of
megabytes, and an implicit download makes a deploy depend on a third party
being up. scripts/download-models.py fetches them; scripts/verify-models.py
checks them before a worker is allowed to rely on them.
Changing a revision here changes transcription or analysis output, so it is
a reviewable change, not a runtime detail.

vad.silero.purpose: Voice-activity signal for the audio classifier (OPTIONAL)

files.name: silero_vad.onnx
files.comment: Size confirmed from the tag's Content-Length. Digest NOT pinned: the upstream release publishes none, and deriving one from a single local download would assert a verification that never happened. Size alone still catches truncation. The classifier degrades to energy-only signals when this file is absent or unreadable, so a missing file is a quality regression rather than a correctness failure.

vad.silero.notes: Requires onnxruntime. Entirely optional; see ADR-005.
